description: Estimate the monthly cost of running a prompt on current AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and others), from thinkhard.si's price catalog, which is checked against each provider's pricing page. Give token counts, or paste the prompt text to estimate them.

calls_per_month.description: How many times the prompt runs in a month, across all users (default 1,000).

input_tokens.description: Input tokens per call. Omit to estimate from prompt_text.

models.description: Optional: model names or ids to include, such as "Claude Sonnet 5.5". Default: every current model.

prompt_text.description: Optional: the prompt, to estimate input tokens (about 4 characters a token).

name: estimate_ai_cost

checked.description: When the prices were last checked against each provider.

input_per_million.description: US dollars per million input tokens.

note.description: Empty unless something about the price needs saying.

output_per_million.description: US dollars per million output tokens.

title: Estimate what an AI feature costs
